messages:
hannah: FYI opened a small PR to reconcile /generate examples with the OpenAPI schema. curl example still used multipart/form-data and the example body didn't match the schema – users were confused. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/599
raj: saw it, thanks. another thing: JS snippet references model alias `gpt4o` but runtime expects `gpt4o-mini`. we should canonicalize model ids in all snippets.
hannah: good catch. I'll normalize to canonical ids and add a tiny mapping table for legacy aliases -> canonical id for migration notes.
nana: (typo: should be ana) runtime note: `files` is an array, `metadata` must be an object, and streaming examples should show SSE headers. I'll add a short SSE curl example.
nana: example I suggest:
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt4o-mini","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
hannah: copied that in; also replaced the old form-data curl with JSON `-d` and set Content-Type properly. added before/after migration snippet for response shape (choices -> content):
Before:
```json
{"choices":[{"text":"ok"}]}
```
After:
```json
{"content":[{"type":"output","text":"ok"}]}
```
raj: nice. can we also add a tiny Go example showing a tolerant unmarshal for both shapes? helps older customers.
hannah: added this Go fragment:
```go
var v map[string]json.RawMessage
json.Unmarshal(body,&v)
if _,ok := v["content"]; ok { /* new path */ } else if _,ok := v["choices"]; ok { /* legacy path */ }
```
docs-bot: PR updated by hannah (docs) — CI: running docs build
tom: small nit: Python snippet used `data=json.dumps(payload)`; prefer `json=payload` for clarity. also unified fence languages to `bash`, `python`, `javascript`.
hannah: switched to `json=` pattern and standardized fences. added the model-alias table, clarified the 30-day acceptance window for legacy field names, and updated OpenAPI snippet (`files: type: array`). CI passed. ready to merge unless any objections.
raj: :thumbsup: looks good to me.
tom: merging after squash.
